rules.label: Grant permit when all positive conditions of § 42 (1) are met.

law_references.quote: The building permit is issued if the building design documentation that has been filed conforms to the requirements established in legislation, i.e., above all to the detailed spatial plan or design specifications and to the requirements for construction works and for building work.
law_references.note: Five-claim positive path to permit issuance.

rules.label: Refuse permit when the project violates the detailed spatial plan (§ 44 1)).

law_references.quote: ... the envisaged construction work does not conform to the detailed spatial plan, design specifications, ... the requirements established for construction works or for building work, or other public-law restrictions;
law_references.note: Hard refusal ground based on plan violation.
